scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0128; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘That guy is Sam.’ and ‘That guy is Leo.’ are grammatical and natural for the bounded informal guy sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps guy to «مرد» and preserves the intended informal reference across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is recognized, practiced in two guided exchanges, checked for listening/meaning, transferred, and retrieved with the answer hidden.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are short A1 alternatives with clearly different meanings or referents.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: آوا و بن در کافه منتظر دوستانشان هستند و آوا دو نفر را از روی جای ایستادنشان شناسایی می‌کند.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner responses are short identification sentences with one new lexical target and familiar grammar.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: guy recurs across recognition, guided speech, listening, transfer, and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the identified person/location cue while preserving the same informal noun sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, turns, and final retrieval all assess the same lexical objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; perceived engagement and register comfort remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded informal noun sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns and response options were checked for grammar, register, and internal consistency.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Story arc returns after 5 Lessons and learner role changes from the prior scene.
